mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in housing starts and consumer spending (as proxied by RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 97.0 for two consecutive months signals a weakening in real economic output, reducing corporate profitability and investor confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 97.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive SPX 5-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three months, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS stable or rising
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and stable/rising FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 3 months
regime_hint: labor market tightening with inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (as measured by GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, combined with weak consumer spending (RSAFS), indicates a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized and RSAFS growth < 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of GDPC1 < 1.0% and RSAFS growth < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
